timetableEvidence: ECTS pages give weekly hours (theory, application/lab), prerequisites, course language, Fall/Spring, weekly topics, but no day, clock-time or room field. Full text read: one syllabus_v2 page (CE 221) and one syllabus page (ECON 101). Keyword-scanned for room, classroom, timetable, salon, derslik, ders programi: all 16 curriculum pages (EN and TR) and 4 GEC pool pages.
Weekly timetable viewer https://analytics.ieu.edu.tr/students_course_program serves a username/password login form (not accessed further).
Announcements titled as course schedules (www.ieu.edu.tr announcements id 9915, oim.ieu.edu.tr id 9430, bdb.ieu.edu.tr id 12875) return "announcement not found / expired".
ilt.ieu.edu.tr/en/program-ve-takvim (VCD Schedule and Calendar) says "There is no content."
Department site menu of CE (ce.ieu.edu.tr) has no timetable entry; room names never appear in any fetched catalog page.
notes: semester = 1..8 from the table titles (Year N Fall = 2N-1, Year N Spring = 2N). semester null = elective pool course, the catalog does not assign a semester to pool courses.

type compulsory = real course code listed in a semester table. type elective with slot = placeholder row in a semester table (slot ELEC = elective course slot, GEC = general education pool slot with pool id, TMD = complementary engineering course slot); code is a placeholder, not a real course.

type elective with pool = real course from the program elective list (ELEC), complementary engineering list (TMD), or ELEC-FIN / ELEC-TRADE (International Trade and Finance). level = first digit of the course number (derived by me, not stated by the catalog).
GEC pool courses (real codes GEHU, GEAR, GEET, GEEC, GEIN) are listed once under gecPools; program POOL nnn slots refer to them.
internship true = summer training or internship row with 0 contact hours and ECTS only, not a lecture.
title is Turkish (lang=tr page), titleEn is English (lang=en page); both are copied as published, dashes normalised to hyphen.
credits: theory and practice are weekly hours as published (Application/Laboratory column), local = local credit, ects = AKTS.

language: only entries in languageVerified were read from a syllabus Course Language field (English or Turkish). Other compulsory rows are inferred (internship rows are null): prefix rules TURK/TRK/HIST/TRH = TR, ENG/ING/IUE = EN, LAW = EN inside the Law program, otherwise the program defaultLanguage (from 2 to 8 sampled syllabi per program). SFL rows and all elective/slot rows are null (SFL target language not stated; syllabus field of SFL 1013 reads English, of SFL 121 is blank). Source typo "Englsih" in EEE 346 was read as English.
Privacy: syllabus pages list instructors and assistants; none of that was recorded.
English preparatory (Hazirlik) modules are not part of the curriculum tables and are not included.
gaps: Weekly timetables and classroom names: not public (see timetableEvidence); the student schedule viewer needs a login.

Only the newest curriculum edition of each program was captured. Earlier cohorts follow older editions (engineering: curr_before2020 and curr_before_2025); in fall 2026 the 3rd and 4th year engineering cohorts likely follow the 2020-2024 edition (my inference from the edition labels). Not captured.
Language is verified for a sample only (46 distinct syllabus pages, 2 to 8 per program); see notes for the inference rules. Elective pool and GEC courses have no language value.
